geo_days.question: Carved into the rugged terrain of Telemark, which deep, east-west glacial valley is so heavily shadowed by steep surrounding mountains that giant hillside heliostat mirrors were installed to illuminate its floor during winter?
geo_days.fun_fact: The idea of using mirrors to illuminate the sun-starved valley was first proposed in 1913 by town founder Sam Eyde, but it took exactly a century to finally be realized.

geo_days.question: Covering roughly 150,000 square kilometers across Helmand and Nimruz provinces, which vast arid plateau in southwestern Afghanistan has a Dari name that translates to the 'Desert of Death'?
geo_days.fun_fact: Despite its lethal name, Dasht-e Margo contains ancient ruins of walled cities and canal networks from medieval civilizations along the Helmand River basin.
